outcomes.name: Understanding of the transition to business as usual has been assessed across all live sites/teams
The transition to business as usual is consistently applied everywhere the change has gone live

actions.action: Recognise that Strategic Direction & Leadership is inconsistent across teams/sites since go-live and gather evidence of where the gaps are in the transition to business as usual.
Identify why the transition to business as usual hasn't landed consistently for Strategic Direction & Leadership in specific teams/sites and agree a plan to address it.
Re-engage leaders in lagging teams/sites to re-establish the transition to business as usual for Strategic Direction & Leadership.
Confirm the transition to business as usual for Strategic Direction & Leadership is being applied consistently across previously inconsistent areas.
Monitor Strategic Direction & Leadership regularly to ensure the transition to business as usual stays consistently reinforced everywhere.
Survey teams/sites to understand how Process & Sustainment has been affected by inconsistent transition to business as usual since go-live.
Develop a targeted plan to address the specific Process & Sustainment-related gaps identified in lagging areas.
Deliver targeted support to strengthen Process & Sustainment in teams/sites where the transition to business as usual is weakest.
Confirm Process & Sustainment has improved in previously lagging teams/sites.
Embed regular pulse-checks on Process & Sustainment so gaps in the transition to business as usual are caught early in future.
